fidelity: Local candle/halo reconstruction, not pixel-perfect paint-layer recovery. See QUALITY_NOTES.md and QA_Report.json.
generation_mode: Built-in ImageGen clean-plate reconstruction and individual particle generation; mechanical local assembly, alpha separation and cropping.
